evidence: From Woolshed Creek car park, cross Woolshed Creek and climb steeply up a rocky ridge.
This section of track eventually rises to its highest point (1080 m) at the junction of the Mount Somers summit hike.
Sharplin Falls car park is at the end of Flynns Road, Staveley.
If you intend to walk only one way from Woolshed Creek car park and require vehicle transport, a local service is available

doubts: The page never states where the South Face Track ends in words; the end is taken as Sharplin Falls car park because 'Getting there' places it at the end of Flynns Road and the one-way transport note implies a different end from Woolshed Creek car park, and F1 is where the South Face Track meets Flynns Road. Woolshed Creek car park (Jig Road end) has no packet feature, so its start has no ref. Woolshed Creek is marked as a ford because the text says to cross it with no bridge mentioned there (the page says there are unbridged stream crossings in general). Acland Shelter is a day shelter 'not intended to be used overnight', so it is not in huts. The 7 hr and 11.6 km are DOC's summary figures for the whole track.
